typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Destination as string (),
	Destination_File_Name as string (),
	DFileName as string (),
	DFileName_Intial as string (),
	EndDate as timestamp (),
	Rename_File as string (),
	Source_File_name as string (),
	Source_File_Path as string (),
	Source_Template as string (),
	StartDate as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		SubscriberID as string,
		First_Name as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		Address1 as string,
		Address2 as string,
		Address3 as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		Zip as string,
		DOB as timestamp,
		{Eligibility Begin date} as date,
		{Eligibility End date} as date,
		{Eligibility Status} as string,
		Source as string,
		Reason as string,
		applicationname as string,
		calltime as timestamp,
		RCRD_STTS_CD as string,
		VRSN_OPEN_DT as timestamp,
		SRC_ADRS_TYPE_CD as string,
		MBR_KEY as string,
		ReportMonth as timestamp,
		Createdate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from ##finalresult',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of Source} = Source,
		{Copy of Zip} = Zip,
		{Copy of Reason} = Reason,
		{Copy of ReportMonth} = ReportMonth,
		{Copy of Createdate} = Createdate,
		{Copy of Address3} = Address3,
		{Copy of Address2} = Address2,
		{Copy of SubscriberID} = SubscriberID,
		{Copy of State} = State,
		{Copy of DOB} = toString(DOB),
		{Copy of Address1} = Address1,
		{Copy of First_Name} = First_Name,
		{Copy of calltime} = calltime,
		{Copy of City} = City,
		{Copy of Last_Name} = Last_Name,
		{Copy of applicationname} = applicationname) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of Zip} as string,
		{Copy of ReportMonth} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Copy of Eligibility End date} as string,
		{Copy of applicationname} as string,
		{Copy of Eligibility Status} as string,
		{Copy of Address2} as string,
		{Copy of Address3} as string,
		{Copy of Address1} as string,
		{Copy of City} as string,
		{Copy of Source} as string,
		{Copy of Reason} as string,
		{Copy of First_Name} as string,
		{Copy of Eligibility Begin date} as string,
		{Copy of Last_Name} as string,
		{Copy of SubscriberID} as string,
		{Copy of State} as string,
		{Copy of DOB} as string,
		{Copy of Createdate} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Copy of calltime} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
